row_labels.prefix1: rank prefix, width 1 (SAE rank 1 on every probe)
row_labels.prefix2: rank prefix, width 2 (SAE ranks 1 and 2 on every probe)
row_labels.complement_none: complement screen + search in SAE order; unfinished -> none
row_labels.complement_guess: complement screen + search in SAE order; unfinished -> guess
row_labels.complement_rand_none: complement screen + search in random order; unfinished -> none
row_labels.complement_rand_guess: complement screen + search in random order; unfinished -> guess
